verdict.rationale: Alloy is API-first. It publishes a full OpenAPI document with sandbox and production bases and offers a Sandbox mode for testing integrations without vendor calls, so it can be driven headlessly from automation or CI pipelines. Workflows can also run on a schedule server-side. However, there is no documented CLI and no CI-specific guidance, and the sandbox is a per-request processing mode with no data boundary rather than an isolated environment. missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration docs, isolated test environment (sandbox shares the production data store), hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Alloy serves its complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at the docs origin (servers sandbox.alloy.co/v1 and api.alloy.co/v1)
Sandbox makes no vendor calls, so you can test your integration without incurring additional charges
Workflows can run in real time as part of a Journey evaluating an incoming application, or on a schedule as a Portfolio workflow
